title: Security: Prevent API DoS via unbounded memory read in manifests handler
body:
The manifests API endpoint previously read the incoming HTTP request payload directly into memory using `io.ReadAll(r.Body)` without an upper bound. This creates a Denial-of-Service vector where a malicious client could send an infinitely streaming payload and OOM crash the podman daemon.

This commit enforces a generous 20MB limit on the payload using `io.LimitReader` to mitigate this.

Fixes #29604
